opportunities.name: American Airlines flight status lookup by flight number and date
opportunities.description: Look up the status of an American Airlines flight by entering a flight number and choosing a departure date on the Flight status tab of aa.com.
steps: Type the flight number into the 'Flight number' field.
Select the travel date in the 'Date' dropdown.

opportunities.name: Amtrak Find Trip lookup by reservation number and last name
opportunities.description: Find an existing Amtrak reservation by entering the 6-digit reservation number and selecting Last Name as the verification field, then submitting Find Trip from the My Trip dialog.
steps: Click 'MY TRIP' in the top navigation.
Type the 6-digit reservation/ticket number into 'Reservation/Ticket Number'.
Open the 'Select' dropdown and choose 'Last Name' (or another verification option).
Type the passenger's last name into the 'Last Name' field.
parameters: verification_type (Email Address / Phone Number / Last Name)
